assessment_scope: Primary-plan singleton docs/plans/2026-09-12-design-directory-layout.md against approved directory-design-review. This is a bounded directory migration delivery package, not allocation or approval of the later unified validation executor initiative.
independence_basis: Separately authorized reviewer agent assessed the author root's relocation and Design amendment without editing any Design, moved example, plan or implementation. Prior hierarchy assessment remains its own preserved subject-specific judgment.
limitations: Implementation results, runtime correctness and milestone completion remain unassessed; expected failing new-path proof does not establish repaired behavior.
Approval is scoped to the registered directory plan. Executor/cache/script cleanup outside this migration remains later allocated work; no whole-change readiness, Verify or publication claim follows.
rationale: The exact primary plan is registered and linked by path/identity in the current v3 change. Its upstream directory-design-review approves the explicit project layout while preserving logical contracts and portable defaults. Actual author is root; reviewer did not edit the plan or Design.

M1 establishes document/example relocation, current navigation and stable model registry reconciliation; independent Design assessment precedes reliance. M2 repairs actual validators, selector defaults/deleted paths/example-owner pairing and fixture consumers, with failing new-path regressions before implementation. This order makes intermediate unsupported paths explicit rather than claiming early completion.

Trace is adequate for this bounded maintenance obligation: System directory ownership and SYS-SR-01/04/06/09 map to M1 coordinated relocation, current identity/preservation checks and recovery; DES-SR-11/12/18/19 path structure, example pairing and fail-closed safety map to M2 boundary/selector/fixture regression commands. The plan names the maintenance obligation directly without inventing another SR series or executor allocation.

Boundary proof covers accepted mapped and retained portable paths, rejected unknown nesting and symlinks, existing invalid old paths versus absent-path selection, example-to-owner pairing, unchanged payloads and requirement rows, live current navigation and preserved historical records. Actual CLI fixture consumers supplement helper/model checks, protecting composed reader behavior and avoiding a vacuous reduced-suite pass.

Named commands include boundary-first validation tests, selector tests, five actual CLI fixture consumer files, all twelve model/prose checks and git diff --check. Snapshot/content comparison and source-reader inspection supply appropriate manual preservation evidence. No network, publication, package generation or unrelated benchmark is necessary for this path-only slice.

Independent review is allocated after the complete directory/reader migration; whole-initiative final independent Code Review and distinct Verify remain required after all later implementation and corrections. A directory checkpoint cannot substitute for those final gates or establish overall readiness.

Risks and recovery identify missed readers, omitted protection and current/historical reference confusion. The exact pre-move content/path snapshot supports reversible restoration, while unknown impacts require source-reader investigation. No old test oracle, runtime authority or historical record may be rewritten merely to obtain passing relocation checks. No material Delivery finding remains.
summary: The registered directory-layout plan provides safe sequencing and adequate focused proof for document relocation and bounded reader repair.
